# Amazon.in
> India-focused Amazon marketplace for shopping, digital payments, Prime benefits, seller services, and customer support.

Amazon.in is Amazon’s Indian storefront, combining consumer shopping with localized programs such as Prime, Amazon Pay, Fresh, business purchasing, and seller services. It also provides structured help, account management, order tracking, and marketplace programs for brands and merchants operating in India.

## Shopping & Discovery
- [Amazon.in Home](https://www.amazon.in/): Main storefront for shopping across electronics, fashion, home, books, and everyday essentials.
- [Best Sellers](https://www.amazon.in/gp/bestsellers): Most purchased products across major categories on Amazon.in.
- [Hot New Releases](https://www.amazon.in/gp/new-releases): Recently launched and fast-rising products across departments.
- [Movers and Shakers](https://www.amazon.in/gp/movers-and-shakers): Products with the biggest recent sales rank gains.
- [Today's Deals](https://www.amazon.in/deals): Time-limited discounts, coupons, and promotional offers across categories.
- [Gift Ideas](https://www.amazon.in/gp/most-gifted): Frequently gifted products across popular shopping categories.
- [Amazon Launchpad](https://www.amazon.in/launchpad): Marketplace section featuring emerging brands and startup products.

## Programs & Membership
- [Amazon Prime](https://www.amazon.in/prime): Membership program with delivery benefits, shopping offers, and bundled Amazon services.
- [Prime Shopping Edition](https://www.amazon.in/amazonprime): Prime membership landing page with plan details and shopping-focused benefits.
- [Amazon Fresh](https://www.amazon.in/fresh): Grocery shopping service for fruits, vegetables, staples, and household essentials.
- [Subscribe & Save](https://www.amazon.in/subscribeandsave): Recurring delivery program for household essentials with scheduled savings.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.amazon.in/gift-card-store): Buy, send, and manage Amazon gift cards and gifting options.
- [Amazon Pay](https://www.amazon.in/amazonpay/home): Payments hub for recharges, bills, travel, and merchant transactions.

## Account, Orders & Lists
- [Your Account](https://www.amazon.in/gp/css/homepage.html): Central dashboard for profile, addresses, payments, and account settings.
- [Your Orders](https://www.amazon.in/gp/css/order-history): Order history, tracking, returns, invoices, and purchase management.
- [Login & Security](https://www.amazon.in/ap/cnep): Manage sign-in, password, and account security preferences.
- [Your Addresses](https://www.amazon.in/a/addresses): Add, edit, and manage shipping and billing addresses.
- [Your Payments](https://www.amazon.in/cpe/yourpayments/wallet): Manage cards, UPI, bank accounts, and payment methods.
- [Your Wish List](https://www.amazon.in/hz/wishlist): Create and manage personal wish lists and saved items.
- [Browsing History](https://www.amazon.in/gp/history): Review and manage recently viewed products.

## Customer Service & Policies
- [Customer Service](https://www.amazon.in/gp/help/customer/display.html): Help hub for orders, returns, payments, devices, and account issues.
- [Returns Centre](https://www.amazon.in/returns): Start returns, replacements, and refund requests for eligible orders.
- [Track Package](https://www.amazon.in/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=G6K4TA5M4NWRX7XY): Help information for shipment tracking and delivery updates.
- [Shipping Rates & Policies](https://www.amazon.in/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201911300): Delivery charges, shipping methods, and fulfillment policy details.
- [Return Policy](https://www.amazon.in/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201149900): Return windows, eligibility rules, and category-specific return conditions.
- [About Our Returns Policies](https://www.amazon.in/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201819200): Overview of refund, replacement, and return handling processes.
- [Amazon.in Conditions of Use](https://www.amazon.in/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=200545940): Terms governing use of the Amazon.in website and services.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.amazon.in/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=200534380): How Amazon collects, uses, and protects customer information.

## Selling on Amazon
- [Sell on Amazon](https://sell.amazon.in/): Seller onboarding, marketplace tools, and business growth resources for merchants.
- [Seller Central](https://sellercentral.amazon.in/): Operational portal for listings, inventory, orders, advertising, and account management.
- [Fulfilment by Amazon](https://sell.amazon.in/fulfillment-by-amazon): Warehousing and fulfillment service for seller inventory and deliveries.
- [Amazon Easy Ship](https://sell.amazon.in/easy-ship): Seller shipping program with Amazon-managed pickup and delivery support.
- [Amazon Seller Fees](https://sell.amazon.in/pricing): Pricing, referral fees, and cost structure for marketplace sellers.
- [Seller University](https://sell.amazon.in/learn): Educational resources and guides for new and existing sellers.
- [Amazon Global Selling India](https://sell.amazon.in/grow-your-business/amazon-global-selling): Cross-border selling program for Indian exporters using Amazon marketplaces.

## Business & B2B
- [Amazon Business](https://www.amazon.in/business): Business purchasing platform with GST invoicing and bulk buying features.
- [Business Prime](https://www.amazon.in/businessprime): Membership benefits tailored for business procurement and team purchasing.
- [GST Invoice Store](https://www.amazon.in/b?node=16179244031): Products and sellers offering GST invoices for business purchases.
- [Amazon Business Registration](https://www.amazon.in/business/register/org/landing): Sign up an organization for Amazon Business purchasing.
- [Business Help](https://www.amazon.in/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=202038670): Support information for Amazon Business accounts and purchasing workflows.

## Devices & Digital Services
- [Kindle eBooks](https://www.amazon.in/kindle-dbs/storefront): Kindle Store for ebooks, digital reading, and related content.
- [Kindle Unlimited](https://www.amazon.in/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku): Ebook subscription service with access to a rotating reading catalog.
- [Audible India](https://www.amazon.in/hz/audible/mlp): Audiobook and spoken-word subscription service for Indian customers.
- [Amazon miniTV](https://www.amazon.in/minitv): Free video entertainment service integrated into the Amazon app experience.
- [App Download](https://www.amazon.in/mobile-apps/b?ie=UTF8&node=1661657031): Download Amazon mobile apps for shopping and related services.
- [Amazon Devices Support](https://www.amazon.in/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GKM69DUUYKQWKWX7): Help resources for Kindle, Fire TV, Echo, and connected devices.

## Language, Preferences & Accessibility
- [Customer Preferences](https://www.amazon.in/customer-preferences/edit): Manage language, currency, and regional shopping preferences.
- [Change Language Settings](https://www.amazon.in/customer-preferences/edit?ie=UTF8&preferencesReturnUrl=%2F&ref_=topnav_lang): Update site language and localized browsing settings.
- [Accessibility Help](https://www.amazon.in/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=202140280): Information about accessibility features and support options.
- [Manage Communication Preferences](https://www.amazon.in/hz/contact-preferences/ca): Control marketing and account communication settings.

## Corporate, Careers & Brand Information
- [About Amazon India](https://www.amazon.in/b?node=6648217031): Corporate information and overview of Amazon’s presence in India.
- [Press Center](https://www.aboutamazon.in/news): News, announcements, and corporate updates related to Amazon in India.
- [Amazon Jobs India](https://www.amazon.jobs/en/locations/india): Careers, hiring information, and open roles across Amazon India locations.
- [Investor Relations](https://www.aboutamazon.com/investor-relations): Financial reporting, governance, and investor information for Amazon.
- [Sustainability](https://www.aboutamazon.com/planet): Amazon-wide sustainability commitments, reporting, and environmental initiatives.
